summary: The Playwright test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly, but the test has weak assertions verifying navigation only by partial URL matching and the selector used to click the product is data-test based but generic. The testCaseId is preserved in the test title. No misuse of Locator or missing awaits is detected. However, navigation validation is too weak to robustly prove the correct product detail page was opened.

issues.description: The assertion verifying the URL change only checks a partial URL matching (/product/) which is too weak to guarantee the correct product detail page was opened.
issues.recommendation: Improve the URL assertion to match the full expected product-specific URL or add additional assertions verifying key product detail elements on the page.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' may be brittle if product identifiers change or are dynamic and the test does not verify the presence of specific product details after navigation.
issues.recommendation: Validate selectors to use stable attributes or add assertions verifying product detail information.

recommendations: Enhance test robustness by adding assertions verifying product-specific page content after navigation.
Consider improving selector strategy for better stability and clarity.
Retain testCaseId references in test titles for traceability.
